mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, rating, comment, comment_ciphertext, comment_key_id, comment_encryption_version, created_at, ip_hash FROM chat_feedback WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_feedback ( message_id, rating, comment, comment_ciphertext, comment_key_id, comment_encryption_version, ip_hash ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{rating}, #{comment}, #{commentCiphertext}, #{commentKeyId}, #{commentEncryptionVersion}, #{ipHash} ) ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE SET rating = EXCLUDED.rating, comment = EXCLUDED.comment, comment_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.comment_ciphertext, comment_key_id = EXCLUDED.comment_key_id, comment_encryption_version = EXCLUDED.comment_encryption_version, ip_hash = EXCLUDED.ip_hash
mapper.select: SELECT id, comment AS plaintext, comment_ciphertext AS ciphertext, comment_key_id AS key_id FROM chat_feedback WHERE comment_ciphertext IS NULL AND comment IS NOT NULL AND comment != '' AND comment != '[encrypted]' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, comment AS plaintext, comment_ciphertext AS ciphertext, comment_key_id AS key_id FROM chat_feedback WHERE comment_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND comment_key_id IS NOT NULL AND comment_key_id != #{activeKeyId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
